tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_6.csv')

# For each (account, service), compute rolling median & std to detect spikes
df = df.sort_values(['SubAccountName','ServiceName','ChargePeriodStart'])

def detect(g):
    x = g['BilledCost'].values
    med = pd.Series(x).rolling(7, center=True, min_periods=1).median().values
    # residual
    res = x - med
    return pd.Series(res, index=g.index)

df['resid'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'], group_keys=False).apply(detect, include_groups=False)
df['absresid'] = df['resid'].abs()

# z-score of residual per group
def z(g):
    s = g['resid'].std()
    return g['resid']/s if s>0 else g['resid']*0
df['z'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'], group_keys=False).apply(z, include_groups=False)

top = df.sort_values('absresid', ascending=False).head(15)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','resid','z']])
